senses.gloss: --a दानव. Br. III. 6. १६.

(I)--a son of तार्क्ष्य (काश्यप) and विनता (सुपर्णा), and vehicle of Hari.
1: भा. VI. 6. २२: III. १९. ११. Br. III. 7. २९: 8. ११. M. 6. ३४: १४६. २२. वा. ४९. १०; ६९. ६६: ७०. ११: ७२. ४५. Vi. I. २१. १८.
Has abode in शाल्मलिद्वीप.
2: भा. V. २०. 8.
Took कृष्ण to Madhuvana;
3: Ib. IV. 9. 1.
Identified with Hari, and regarded as the embodiment of the Vedas.
4: Ib. VI 8. २९. VIII. 3. ३१.
Attacked Asura followers of Bali, and knowing Hari's mind, he bound Bali with cords of वरुण.
5: Ib. VIII. २१. १६ and २६.
Serves as a watch for क्षीरोद. When he saw Bali carrying away Hari's crown-jewel, he pursued him and recovered it after a fight. When he saw on his return from Gomanta, he placed it on His [page१-519+ ४६] head and belauded him, requesting him for opportunities of service to Him, who ordered him to go back and come whenever He thought of him.
6: Ib. X. ५३ (V) १०-19.
His winning nectar is com- pared to कृष्ण winning वैदर्भी in स्वयम्वर।
7: Ib. X. ५२. १७.
कालीय, the enemy of snakes, freed from fear of; entered into an agreement with snakes of रमणक to give him बलि every fortnight. कालीय failed to do this, and after a fight escaped to the river कालिन्दी where गरुड could not go, as he was under a curse. It happened once that गरुड took a king- fish from the river against the wish of the sage Saubhari who cursed that गरुड's coming again there would mean the end of his life.
8: Ib. १६. ६३; १७. 1-११. Vi. V. 7. ७८.
Attacked by Mura,
9: भा. X. ५९. 7-8.
killed all elephants of Naraka,
१०: Ib. ५९. १९. Vi. V. २९. १४.
carried कृष्ण to Indra's city. Defeated वरुण attacking कृष्ण, flung शिव and his bull to a distance of a hundred धनुस्। Discomfited ऐरावत of Indra, and took कृष्ण and सत्यभामा safely to द्वारका.
११: भा. ६५ (V) 1: ६६ (V) २२-25, ४८; ६७ (V) ११-14, ३८-39, M. १५०. २१९ Vi. V. ३०. ६४-70. XI. ३०. ४४.
गरुड standard of Hari.
१२: Br. III. ७१. २४८.
Praise of Hari.
१३: भा. IV. ३०. 6. XI. २७. २८.
Took nectar for mother's sake to Somaka hill of प्लक्ष; married five daughters of ताम्र and became father of birds in all the world.
१४: Br. II. १९. ११-12: III. 7. ४४८-51: M. १२२. १५.
Younger brother of अरुण.
१५: M. १५०-53.
Worship of, on the भी- मद्वादशि, and in the लक्ष homa of Grahabali. Icon of.
१६: M. ५३. ४१; ६९. २६; ९३. ९९: २५८. ११ and १२.
In the तारकामय: in the war with कालनेमी: performed tapas at Kanakhala.
१७: M. १५२. 6-7, ३६: १५३. १८१: १७१. ५०: १७८. ३२ and ५०: १९३. ७०: २४९. ३५
had a number of wives, sons and grandsons; the eater of all cruel snakes--his descendants spread over largely the whole of शाल्मलिद्वीप, and the mountains देवकूट, मणिमन्त, सहस्रशिखर, Parna- mala, सुकेश, and सतश्रुग, the five-peaked Kauraja, हेमकूट etc.
१८: वा. ६९. ३२८-335.
[page१-520+ ३०]
(II)--a son of विश्वेशा. M. १७१. ५०.
--a महापुराण comprising १९००० s4lokas. भा. XII. 7. २३: १३. 8: Vi. IV. 6. २३.
--a goddess following भवमालिनी. M. १७९. ७१.
(I)--a son of (Bhuva) Manyu and father of शिनि, (Chini). M. ४९. ३६: Vi. IV. १९. २१-23.

(II)--the Purohita of यादवस्. Urged by Vasudeva, he went to the Vraja of Nanda who welcomed him as befitted a Guru, praising him as the great author of ज्योतिष s4a1stra. Requested by Nanda to do नाम सम्स्कार to कृष्ण and राम without कंश's knowledge, he did so and returned to his place.
1: भा. X. 8. 1-२०. Vi. II. 5. २६: V. 6. 8. 9.
He held कृष्ण and राम to be divine incarnations.
2: भा. X. ४६. २३.
He informed Nanda that कृष्ण was the son of Vasudeva and an अम्श of नारायण.
3: Ib. २६. १५-23.
He officiated at उपनयन सम्स्कारस् of the two brothers.
4: Ib. ४५. २६-29.
He had also informed Mucukunda that नारायण was to be born on [page१-521+ २६] the earth as कृष्ण.
5: Ib. ५१. ४५.
He was invited for the राजसूय of युधिष्ठिर.
6: Ib. ७४. 8.
(III)--an Angirasa and a मन्त्रकृत्. Br. II. ३२. १०७: M. १४५. १०१.
(IV)--the Purohita of Haiha. Br. III. २८. ३९.
(V)--a son of Pratardana. Br. III. ६७. ६९: वा. ९२. ६५.

(VI)--the preceptor of the seven sons of कौशिक who tended his cow, killed and made a meal of it in a famine. For this sin they were cursed to have five rebirths; no mar- riage alliance with बृहस्पति. M. २०. 3: १९६. २४.
(VII)--an author of architecture. M. २५२. 3.
(VIII)--a ऋत्विक् at ब्रह्मा's sacrifice. वा. १०६. ३५.
--a son of Bhuvamanyu. वा. ९९. १५९.
--the son of गार्ग्य; of Vatsa line. Br. III. ६७. ७८.
--a तीर्थम् on the नर्मदा. M. १९१. ८२. 3.
--a तीर्थम् near यन्त्रेश्वर on the Nar- मदा. M. १९०. 3. [page१-522+ ३१]
--a वर्ण s4akti. Br. IV. ४४. ६०.
--a son of वसिष्ठ and ऊर्जा. Br. II. ११. ४१.
--the asses of the तामस line. Vi. I. २१. १७.
--a son of Bali. वा. ६७. ८३.

--ten rulers of this line are distin- guished; see Maunas.
1: भा. XII. 1. २९. Vi. IV. २४. ५१.
Seven of them ruled for ७२ years (९४, म्। प्।) after आभिरस्.
2: Br. III. ७४. १७२ and 4: M. २७३. १८-20: वा. ९९. ३५९.
--a mind-born mother. M. १७९. १८.
--one of the पञ्चार्षेयस् and a भार्गव. M. १९५. ३४.
--a Pravara sage. M. १९९. १६.
(I)--a son of Turvasu. M. ४८. 1.

(II)--the child in embryo;
1: भा. III. ३१. 1-१०. वा. ९७. ४६-57.
a union of शुक्र-- springing from मज्ज which is from bone which is due to मेदस्, which again results from flesh, that is due to शोणितम्, emerging from Rasa or waters, शुक्र constitutes of Soma and सोणितम् of अग्नी. The former resides in Kaphavarga and the latter in Pittavarga. The place of कफ is heart, and that of पित्त is the navel region. Stages in the गर्भ and formation described.
2: Br. III. ७२. ४५-57. वा. १४. १८-26.
[page१-523+ २७]

(III)--the four central parts out of १६, into which a site (of a temple to be built) is divided; measure- ments of its foundations, walls, doorways, etc.; likewise other parts of temple bear specific relation to the गर्भ। M. २६९. 1-8.
--a son of गार्ग्य. वा. ९२. ७३.
--a ceremonial connected with preg- nancy; a सम्स्कार. Br. III. ४२. ४३: M. २७५. १६.
--restrictions to be observed by, laid down by काश्यप for Diti: Her failure to observe them gave Indra the loophole he was seeking to destroy her foetus; see Diti, Indra. M. 7. ३७, ४७: ५२. 4.
--a सुधर्मान god. Br. IV. 1. ६०.
--the १४थ् kalpa; an account of, in the गरुड Pura1n2a. M. ५३. ५३; २९०. 6.
--the पुराण of १९००० verses narrated by कृष्ण in the गारुड kalpa; the origin of गरुड from the mundane egg; a gift of, takes one to शिव loka, see गारुड Pura1n2a. M. ५३. ५३-4.
--सुग्रीव, the enemy of snakes in the Vai- कारिक hill. वा. ३९. ४०. [page१-531+ २७]
(I)--a contemporary of वासुदेव-Kr2s2n2a. Br. III. ७३. ९४.
(II)--a वीथी comprising स्रवण, धनिष्ठ and शतभिषक्. वा. ६६. ५१.
(I)--a son of शिनि. From क्षत्रियस्, ब्राह्- मण lines came into being. भा. IX. २१. १९.
(III)--an आर्षेय pravara of भार्गवस्. M. १९५. ३८.
(V)--a son of ऋषभ, the avatar of the lord. वा. २३. १४४. [page१-532+ ३०]
(VI)--a son of the avatar of the २८थ् dva1para. वा. २३. २२३.

(VII)--a pupil of भाष्कल; was childless and hence was ridiculed as impotent by स्याल; was engaged in penance for महादेव for a son by living on iron ore; was appointed to produce a child on the Yavana queen and the son was कालयवन. Vi. III. 4. २५; V. २३. 1-5.
--क्षत्रिय-Brahmans. वा. ९९. १६१. Vi. IV. १९. २३.
--a pravara. M. १९६. ३१.
--a भार्गव gotrakara. M. १९५. २३.

--the sacrificial fire; Dharmavrata per- formed austerities standing in this fire;
1: वा. ९७. २५, १११.
the face of the Veda.
2: Ib. १०४. ८५; १०६. ४१.
Nirmathya agni; father of two sons, शम्स्य and शुक्र.
3: Br. I. १२. ११; वा. २९. ११.
--a भार्गव gotrakara. M. १९५. २३.
